raw: Act 2, Scene 1 — An open place adjoining Capulet’s Garden

sentences.en: An open place adjoining Capulet’s Garden
sentences.ko: 캐퓰릿 집 정원 옆의 빈터

summary.en: After the party, Romeo climbs into the Capulet garden. His friends look for him and joke about his love for Rosaline.
summary.ko: 잔치가 끝난 뒤 로미오는 담을 넘어 캐퓰릿 가의 정원으로 들어간다. 친구들은 그를 찾으며 로잘린을 향한 그의 사랑을 놀린다.

speaker: CHORUS
raw:
Now old desire doth in his deathbed lie,
And young affection gapes to be his heir;
That fair for which love groan’d for and would die,
With tender Juliet match’d, is now not fair.
Now Romeo is belov’d, and loves again,
Alike bewitched by the charm of looks;
But to his foe suppos’d he must complain,
And she steal love’s sweet bait from fearful hooks:
Being held a foe, he may not have access
To breathe such vows as lovers use to swear;
And she as much in love, her means much less
To meet her new beloved anywhere.
But passion lends them power, time means, to meet,
Tempering extremities with extreme sweet.

sentences.en: Now old desire lies in its deathbed.
sentences.ko: 이제 옛 욕망은 임종의 자리에 누웠습니다.

sentences.en: Young affection is ready to take its place.
sentences.ko: 젊은 사랑이 그 자리를 이으려 합니다.

sentences.en: The beauty Romeo once longed for and would die for now seems plain next to tender Juliet.
sentences.ko: 로미오가 한때 목숨까지 바치려던 그 아름다움도, 이제 어여쁜 줄리엣 곁에서는 평범해 보입니다.

sentences.en: Now Romeo is loved, and he loves again.
sentences.ko: 이제 로미오는 사랑받고, 또 사랑합니다.

sentences.en: Both are enchanted by each other's looks.
sentences.ko: 두 사람은 서로의 모습에 반했습니다.

sentences.en: But he must tell his love to a girl from his enemy's family.
sentences.ko: 하지만 그는 원수 집안의 딸에게 사랑을 고백해야 합니다.

sentences.en: And she must take love's sweet bait from a dangerous hook.
sentences.ko: 그녀는 위험한 낚싯바늘에서 사랑의 달콤한 미끼를 물어야 합니다.

sentences.en: Because he is seen as an enemy, he cannot visit her.
sentences.ko: 원수로 여겨지기에 그는 그녀를 찾아갈 수 없습니다.

sentences.en: He cannot say the vows that lovers usually swear.
sentences.ko: 연인들이 흔히 하는 맹세도 할 수 없습니다.

sentences.en: She is just as much in love.
sentences.ko: 그녀도 그만큼 사랑에 빠졌습니다.

sentences.en: But she has even fewer ways to meet her new love.
sentences.ko: 하지만 그녀에게는 새 연인을 만날 길이 더욱 없습니다.

sentences.en: But passion gives them power, and time gives them chances to meet.
sentences.ko: 그러나 열정은 그들에게 힘을 주고, 시간은 만날 기회를 줍니다.

sentences.en: It mixes extreme danger with extreme sweetness.
sentences.ko: 극한의 위험에 극한의 달콤함을 섞어서 말입니다.

speaker: ROMEO
raw:
Can I go forward when my heart is here?
Turn back, dull earth, and find thy centre out.

sentences.en: Can I move forward when my heart is here?
sentences.ko: 내 마음이 여기 있는데 내가 앞으로 나아갈 수 있을까?

sentences.en: My heart is here, in this house.
sentences.ko: 내 마음은 이 집 안에 있다.

sentences.en: Turn back, dull body, and go to it.
sentences.ko: 무딘 몸아, 뒤로 돌아 저곳으로 가거라.

raw: He climbs the wall and leaps down within it.

sentences.en: Romeo climbs the wall and jumps down inside it.
sentences.ko: 로미오가 담을 타고 올라가 안으로 뛰어내린다.

sentences.en: Romeo! My cousin Romeo! Romeo!
sentences.ko: 로미오! 내 사촌 로미오! 로미오!

speaker: MERCUTIO
raw:
He is wise,
And on my life hath stol’n him home to bed.

sentences.en: He is wise.
sentences.ko: 그 녀석은 영리해.

sentences.en: And I swear on my life that he has gone home to bed.
sentences.ko: 그리고 그가 집으로 돌아가 잠들었다고 내 목숨을 걸고 장담해.

speaker: BENVOLIO
raw:
He ran this way, and leap’d this orchard wall:
Call, good Mercutio.

sentences.en: He ran this way and jumped over this orchard wall, so call out, good Mercutio.
sentences.ko: 그가 이쪽으로 달려와 과수원 담장을 넘어왔으니, 소리쳐 불러봐, 좋은 친구 머큐쇼.

speaker: MERCUTIO
raw:
Nay, I’ll conjure too.
Romeo! Humours! Madman! Passion! Lover!
Appear thou in the likeness of a sigh,
Speak but one rhyme, and I am satisfied;
Cry but ‘Ah me!’ Pronounce but Love and dove;
Speak to my gossip Venus one fair word,
One nickname for her purblind son and heir,
Young Abraham Cupid, he that shot so trim
When King Cophetua lov’d the beggar-maid.
He heareth not, he stirreth not, he moveth not;
The ape is dead, and I must conjure him.
I conjure thee by Rosaline’s bright eyes,
By her high forehead and her scarlet lip,
By her fine foot, straight leg, and quivering thigh,
And the demesnes that there adjacent lie,
That in thy likeness thou appear to us.

sentences.en: No, I will call him up like a magician too.
sentences.ko: 아니, 나도 마법사처럼 그를 불러내겠어.

sentences.en: Romeo! Moods! Madman! Passion! Lover!
sentences.ko: 로미오! 변덕쟁이! 미치광이! 열정! 연인이여!

sentences.en: Appear in the form of a sigh.
sentences.ko: 한숨의 형상으로 나타나라.

sentences.en: Speak just one rhyme and I will be satisfied.
sentences.ko: 단 한 줄의 운문만이라도 말하면 만족할 거야.

sentences.en: Cry out 'Ah me!'
sentences.ko: '아, 슬프다!'라고 외쳐라.

sentences.en: Say only Love and dove.
sentences.ko: '사랑'과 '비둘기'라는 말만이라도 해.

sentences.en: Tell my friend Venus one fair word.
sentences.ko: 내 수다쟁이 친구 비너스에게 좋은 말 한마디 해 줘.

sentences.en: Give one nickname to her blind son and heir.
sentences.ko: 그녀의 눈먼 아들이자 후계자에게 별명을 하나 붙여줘라.

sentences.en: Young Cupid shot so well when King Cophetua loved the beggar girl.
sentences.ko: 코페투아 왕이 거지 소녀를 사랑할 때 큐피드가 아주 잘 쏘았지.

sentences.en: He does not hear, he does not move, and he does not stir.
sentences.ko: 그는 듣지도, 움직이지도, 꿈쩍도 하지 않아.

sentences.en: The monkey is playing dead, so I must call him up with magic.
sentences.ko: 원숭이가 죽은 척하니, 주문으로 불러내야겠군.

sentences.en: I call you up by Rosaline's bright eyes, by her high forehead and her red lip.
sentences.ko: 로잘린의 빛나는 눈과 높은 이마, 그리고 붉은 입술로 너를 부른다.

sentences.en: By her fine foot, straight leg, and shaking thigh, and by the parts that lie near them.
sentences.ko: 그녀의 아름다운 발과 곧은 다리, 흔들리는 허벅지, 그리고 그 근처에 있는 부분들로 말이야.

sentences.en: Appear to us in your likeness.
sentences.ko: 너의 본모습으로 우리 앞에 나타나라.

speaker: BENVOLIO
raw: An if he hear thee, thou wilt anger him.

sentences.en: If he hears you, you will make him angry.
sentences.ko: 네가 그렇게 부르면 그가 화를 낼 거야.

speaker: MERCUTIO
raw:
This cannot anger him. ’Twould anger him
To raise a spirit in his mistress’ circle,
Of some strange nature, letting it there stand
Till she had laid it, and conjur’d it down;
That were some spite. My invocation
Is fair and honest, and, in his mistress’ name,
I conjure only but to raise up him.

sentences.en: This cannot make him angry.
sentences.ko: 이건 그를 화나게 하지 않아.

sentences.en: It would only anger him if I made a strange spirit rise up in his girlfriend's magic circle.
sentences.ko: 애인의 마법진 안에 이상한 영혼을 세워 놓는다면 그야 화를 내겠지.

sentences.en: That spirit would stay there until she had laid it and sent it away.
sentences.ko: 그녀가 그걸 눕혀서 가라앉힐 때까지 말이야.

sentences.en: That would be mean.
sentences.ko: 그건 너무 심한 일이지.

sentences.en: My request is fair and honest.
sentences.ko: 내 요청은 공정하고 정직해.

sentences.en: I am using her name only to make him appear.
sentences.ko: 나는 단지 그를 나타나게 하려고 그녀의 이름을 쓰는 것뿐이야.

speaker: BENVOLIO
raw:
Come, he hath hid himself among these trees
To be consorted with the humorous night.
Blind is his love, and best befits the dark.

sentences.en: Come, he has hidden himself among these trees.
sentences.ko: 이리 와, 그는 이 나무들 사이에 숨어 있어.

sentences.en: He wants to be with the moody night.
sentences.ko: 그는 축축하고 변덕스러운 밤과 함께 있고 싶은 거야.

sentences.en: His love is blind.
sentences.ko: 그의 사랑은 눈이 멀었어.

sentences.en: It is best for his love to stay in the dark.
sentences.ko: 그의 사랑에는 어둠이 제일 어울려.

speaker: MERCUTIO
raw:
If love be blind, love cannot hit the mark.
Now will he sit under a medlar tree,
And wish his mistress were that kind of fruit
As maids call medlars when they laugh alone.
O Romeo, that she were, O that she were
An open-arse and thou a poperin pear!
Romeo, good night. I’ll to my truckle-bed.
This field-bed is too cold for me to sleep.
Come, shall we go?

sentences.en: If love is blind, love cannot hit the mark.
sentences.ko: 사랑이 눈이 멀었다면, 목표를 맞출 수도 없겠지.

sentences.en: Now he will sit under a medlar tree.
sentences.ko: 이제 그는 서양모과 나무 아래 앉아 있겠지.

sentences.en: He will wish his girl were a medlar.
sentences.ko: 자기 여자가 서양모과였으면 하고 바라겠지.

sentences.en: Girls laugh that the medlar looks like a bottom.
sentences.ko: 여자애들은 서양모과가 엉덩이처럼 생겼다며 낄낄대.

sentences.en: Oh Romeo, I wish she were that bottom-shaped fruit, and you a long, pointed pear!
sentences.ko: 오 로미오, 그녀가 그 엉덩이 모양 과일이고 네가 길쭉하고 뾰족한 배라면 좋을 텐데!

sentences.en: Romeo, good night.
sentences.ko: 로미오, 잘 자라.

sentences.en: I will go to my own bed.
sentences.ko: 나는 내 침대로 갈 거야.

sentences.en: This field-bed is too cold for me to sleep.
sentences.ko: 이런 맨땅 침대는 너무 추워서 잘 수가 없어.

sentences.en: Come, shall we go?
sentences.ko: 자, 이제 가자.

speaker: BENVOLIO
raw:
Go then; for ’tis in vain
To seek him here that means not to be found.

sentences.en: Go then.
sentences.ko: 그럼 가자.

sentences.en: It is useless to look for him here.
sentences.ko: 여기서 그를 찾는 건 소용없어.

sentences.en: He does not want to be found.
sentences.ko: 그는 발견되기를 원치 않아.
